## Highlights

- **Updates itself, on macOS too**: a gift icon at the bottom left, one click to restart into it.
- **Run history** for Duo Loop, Agent Swarm and Orchestrator, with a replayable map and *Run again*.
- **Real token use and cost** of agent runs, with a cost limit that stops a run.
- **AI-written commit messages**, a commit box with Commit & Push, and Vulgr as co-author.
- Pause, resume and stop Agent Swarm and Orchestrator; restart a single Orchestrator agent.
- Templates for goals and teams, system notifications, find in the terminal, and custom keyboard shortcuts.
- New octopus logo and a black-and-white look; the interface in eight languages.

This version has to be installed by hand once (download it below); later versions update from inside the app.
